scope: Internal Model application source admission and Desktop/Managed host composition before public plan and registration
evidence_policy: Fresh exact candidate checks and actual separate-invocation review govern component completion. This descriptive record grants no parent or work-chunk pass.
controls: Use existing ModelDownloadTasksUseCase descriptors/observedOwners and OwnedTaskReconciler. Copy exact compatible source/pin/manifest/workspace and original organization/principal; require ModelWrite and live original controls. Reserve bounded ownership before awaits. One issuance acknowledgement precedes installed-only source readiness.

Unknown acknowledgement, start or result identity retains protected scope without discovery, adoption, repeated issue or native cleanup credit. Reconciliation and runtime-stop callbacks cannot free unknown Node ownership. Capacity denies new effects before admission.

Accepted source results capture exact identity and original read/cancel/completion methods. Shared history eviction or ID reuse cannot substitute a job. Pending lists never enumerate a guessed ID. Outward activities contain no private handle, callback or local path.

Desktop and Managed composition reuse the same captured foundation cache/session and existing generated-model storage. HF_HUB_CACHE precedes HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE and TRANSFORMERS_CACHE; relative explicit roots fail. Missing source support cannot install or fall back to ordinary runtime behavior.
Transfer/storage completion remains separate from Model registration. Ordinary completion refuses source-owned tasks. Existing ordinary download start/read/list/cancel/complete remains unchanged.
focused_observations: Twelve focused application cases cover actor/identity/permission/ACK ordering, copied immutable inputs and callback identity across held ACK, missing support, active inputs, unknown admission, protected capacity, foreign actors and result identity, no-discovery listings and original-handle mutation/replacement denial.

Eighteen private acquisition cases include a new regression that completes a source, rotates 270 shared-history entries, reuses its ID for training and verifies original status/completion/cancellation without reading or changing the replacement.

Five host configuration tests cover captured cache/session, alias compatibility, installed-only Desktop runtime support, lazy application forwarding and production source wiring in both hosts. These are component/wiring evidence, not a real-host UI journey.

The mandatory actual controlled Node-to-owned-Python source case now passes a second source acquisition through the application owner and existing Task/storage. It verifies exact persisted synthetic bytes, closed transfer inventory, reconciler settlement and no implicit Model registration.

Focused related ordinary Model use-case and runtime HTTP tests preserve existing behavior. Strict transitive type checks, server build, documentation, agent-support, control-plane and architecture remain separate recorded checks.

Earlier ad hoc strict compile failures were test-only missing concurrencyClass and union narrowing. They were corrected without changing application limits. The first new routing test omitted a mandatory requested check; its input was corrected and both routing test files passed.

Independent review found three gaps: an old ordinary application descriptor could consume a later source completion by reused ID; shutdown during held ACK could admit new source work; and Worker cache selection disagreed with Node for alias/legacy conflicts. Generic completion now refuses every source-owned result; only its captured original handle supplies completion. New admission separately rechecks reconciler acceptance without blocking accepted cleanup. Foundation canonicalizes the captured root into child HF_HUB_CACHE; the mandatory actual producer case executes the actual Worker cache helper with distinct alias/legacy paths. Causal regressions cover all three.

The first candidate-bound attempt passed eleven groups and failed the helper routing gate. Its immutable failed receipt is retained. Shared production host files no longer automatically select Model-specific profiles; exact source tests select them, and explicitly requested current profiles still cover the declared wiring. Unknown files and explicit generic checks retain fallback. A later cross-boundary test variable collision and incomplete regression fixture capacity setup were corrected before fresh qualification.

The second candidate attempt passed eleven groups, including actual producer, types, runtime/host and helper checks, but the Model unit group returned exit 1. The executor retained its status and bounded output digests, not assertion text. The unchanged group's diagnostic run then passed 263 tests with the one deliberate Node-only actual-producer skip; two more repeats under the executor's exact child environment also passed 263 each. No application guard, expectation or check was relaxed. Both failed receipts remain preserved; fresh exact candidate verification and independent review are still required. The intermittent assertion cause was not reproduced and remains an explicit diagnostic limitation for later aggregate qualification.

Further review narrowed all approved-source read/cancel/completion access to the original captured handle and excludes source rows before generic list refresh and output. A real old ordinary descriptor after history rotation cannot read/list/cancel/register a later queued source; the actual original handle still cancels and settles safely. The Worker generic cancellation route refuses source owners before touching a Future, so a delayed old request cannot cancel a later queued source; exact bound cancellation remains supported. Eighteen Node acquisition and twenty-eight authenticated Worker source-task cases passed after this change.

The third unchanged candidate again failed the Model unit group while all eleven other groups passed. A diagnostic invocation of the actual unchanged executor with bounded local stream mirroring then passed the same 263 tests. The failed receipts are retained. The scoped successor adds bounded failure diagnostics: only existing catalog-selected repository test locations and fixed error kinds/codes/counts may be recorded, never raw messages, local absolute prefixes or arbitrary output. Streaming hash/output/time/process limits remain unchanged. Eight focused privacy, confinement, bound and actual-child checks pass. This makes any recurrence diagnosable without weakening qualification or silently treating failure as success.

Independent privacy review found ordinary confinement permits aliases that resolve inside the repository. Diagnostic location admission now first walks at most thirty-two canonical lexical ancestors/file with lstat and rejects symlinks, Windows reparse points and wrong object kinds. An actual inside-repo junction negative passed with the other seven diagnostics cases in the permitted local environment after restricted junction creation was denied. This is bounded advisory path observation, not native hostile-writer fencing or a guard waiver.
qualification_limits: No public source plan/permission/execution/status or scoped registry-save operation is introduced. Internal callbacks do not supply user approval.
Controlled synthetic source bytes are not loadable model weights, provider transfer, actual Desktop/Managed UI, native hostile-writer, durable restart or output-quality proof.

Accepted model accuracy stays closed; no new model/dependency/engine/provider/binary or production process is added. Parent I7, its planned chunks and final comprehensive qualification remain pending.

Primary control-plane storage capacity still prevents importing further isolated work receipts. Preserve all immutable history and bounds; descriptive committed component reports are not substituted for missing primary receipts.
